title: seseli elatum subsp. osseum
intro: Seseli elatum subsp. osseum, commonly known as Mountain Fennel, is a plant species native to the mountainous regions of Europe. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal activities, which can aid in the relief of respiratory issues, digestive problems, and skin irritations. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Fennel include expectorant, carminative, and spasmolytic properties, making it a potential treatment for coughs, nausea, and muscle cramps. Bioactive constituents present in the plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
